items.html: *And now we shall explain the Tzadi of the Tzelem, which is made from the first NHY of the third Tevunah, which is the second. And behold, the lights, which are the Mochin of ZA, are clothed within them, and the garment is drawn after the spirituality and is secondary to it. Therefore everything is considered and attributed to the body of ZA and not to Tevunah. And the garment departs from its first nature, which was that of Tevunah, and becomes the very nature of ZA, and they return to be the actual body of ZA, and are called bone from his bone and flesh from his flesh, for the body conducts itself after the spirituality that is within them.
